name: kabadiwala-connect
description: Smart Informal Waste & EPR Integration Platform — SIH 2026

scripts.build:web: cd apps/web && npm run build && cp -r dist/* ../../ && cp dist/index.html ../../view-website.html
scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:api
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cd apps/web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:open: cd apps/web && npx cap open android
scripts.build:apk: npm run cap:sync && export JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/.tools/jdk-21.0.4+7} && export PATH=$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH && export ANDROID_HOME=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/.tools/android-sdk} && cd apps/web/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug

author: Kabadiwala Connect Team
